test_item:
"ValidityCounter" is 2byte value(“0”-“65535”),a parameter of configuration file
(number of ignition cycles reaches 65535 and exceeds ValidityCounter)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Read /data/vendor/dauth/vc on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/vc
2. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/vc output shows the ValidityCounter value 65535
2. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
